description.zh: 一行一个习惯，点一格就记下那一天；连续天数自己算
description.en: One habit per row — tap a cell to log the day; the streak counts itself

help.zh: 只决定这一周那七格从哪天起排，已经记下的日期一格都不动。
help.en: Only decides which day the seven cells start on; recorded dates are untouched.

items.zh: 点一格就是那天做过了，再点一下取消。今天的格子有一圈细边。
items.en: Tap a cell to mark that day done; tap again to undo. Today's cell has a thin ring.

items.zh: 只能点这一周那七格 —— 往前补记请在本周内点，更早的日子要在卡片里改就太容易点错了。
items.en: Only this week's seven cells are tappable. Backfilling much further would make a stray tap too costly.

items.zh: 记的是本地日期，不是 UTC：过了零点才算新的一天，换时区也不会把昨天挪走。
items.en: Days are local — a new day starts at local midnight, and changing time zones does not move yesterday.

items.zh: 格子右边那个数字是从今天（今天还没记的话从昨天）往前数的连续天数。
items.en: The number beside the cells counts back from today — or from yesterday if today is not logged yet.

items.zh: 今天还没记不算断：它显示到昨天为止的连续天数，今天补上就接着长。
items.en: An empty today does not break it: the number runs to yesterday, and logging today extends it.

items.zh: 断一天就从 1 重新开始 —— 这里不发明「豁免日」。
items.en: One missed day resets it to 1. There are no invented grace days.

items.zh: 点名字就地改，回车或点开别处生效，Esc 放弃。
items.en: Click a name to edit it in place. Enter or clicking away commits; Esc cancels.

items.zh: 行尾那颗 × 会把这个习惯连同它记过的日子一起删掉，没有撤销。
items.en: The × at the end of a row deletes the habit and its history, with no undo.

items.zh: 最多六个习惯，第七个会被挡住并说明原因。
items.en: Six habits at most; a seventh is refused and says why.

items.zh: 每个习惯卡片的每一格都来自同一份数据 —— 它们是同一条记录的几个视图。
items.en: Every Habit card reads the same data — they are views of one record.

items.zh: 在画布上点一格，桌面上的那份会自己刷新；反过来也一样。
items.en: Log a day on the canvas and the desktop copy refreshes itself, and the other way round.

items.zh: 想要第二份互不相干的清单，得换个 id 再装一份。
items.en: A second, independent list means installing a copy under a different id.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：一行一个习惯、一周七格、连续天数，记的是本地日期。
changes.en: First release: one habit per row, seven cells a week, a streak, all keyed on the local date.

changes.zh: 点名字就地改名，行尾 × 删除，最多六个习惯。
changes.en: Rename in place by clicking the name, delete from the ×, and six habits at most.

changes.zh: 一周从周一还是周日开始可以在属性面板里改。
changes.en: Whether the week starts on Monday or Sunday is a setting in the inspector.

changes.zh: 界面与说明都是中英双语。
